_sunlit_sands_notes: Sunlit Sands: hand-shipped VS Code theme. Omarchy's built-in template generates this file from colors.toml; a copy shipped in the theme folder replaces that output (for the author and for anyone who installs the theme). This field lists every key that differs from the template's output so it can be found and changed by hand. VS Code ignores this field.

To regenerate after a palette change: delete this file from the theme folder, run `omarchy theme refresh`, copy ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/vscode-theme.json back into the theme folder, then re-apply the changes below.

Colour roles: sand page = background #f7f1e3; chrome (activity strip, title bar, status bar, tab strip, inactive tabs) = dark_background #dbe7f2; selected/hovered rows and pills = lighter_background #bcd8f5; dividers = darker_background #bfd3e6. Button hover (menu bar, toolbar, status bar items, search box) = lighter_background #bcd8f5; pressed = darker_background #bfd3e6.
minimapSlider.activeBackground: template #5d6b7d60 -> shipped #2470b060 (blue at 38%, while dragging; translucent so the code preview shows through)
minimapSlider.hoverBackground: template #5d6b7d40 -> shipped #2a78b040 (accent at 25%, pointer on it)
scrollbarSlider.background: template #5d6b7d40 -> shipped #bcd8f5 (lighter_background, pointer on the track)
scrollbarSlider.hoverBackground: template #5d6b7d80 -> shipped #2a78b0 (accent, pointer on the bar)
statusBarItem.compactHoverBackground: template #5d6b7d -> shipped #f3e2a0 (selection gold: the item under the pointer inside the compact git group; the group itself uses hoverBackground)
